bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 70
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 71
test ! -L "$root/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" || exit 72
git -C "$root" cat-file -e f752826458a705b14f28e89114334d404c5f7c0a^{commit} || exit 73
old="$(git -C "$root" show f752826458a705b14f28e89114334d404c5f7c0a:scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
live="$(sha256sum "$root/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
test "$old" = "$live" || exit 74
git -C "$root" fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/chat/bug-report-userbot-20261115 || exit 75
test "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 9e6659188f5d67f436bb83d532417a882d8db78a || exit 76
echo USERBOT_SOURCE_PREFLIGHT_MATCH
